svg.title: Developer Experience Redefined: Prisma & Cloudflare Lead the Way to Data DX
svg.desc: TypeMark — Data DX, the term Prisma introduces in this post, set as a giant Sora mark, with the Cloudflare partnership named in the kicker. Prisma blog cover, light paper surface, yellow prism accent.

g.text: Accelerate’s edge cache is built on Cloudflare CDN and Workers
